results.sql:
SELECT
  promo_gmv, promo_ord_cnt, promo_aov,
  normal_gmv, normal_ord_cnt, normal_aov,
  ROUND(promo_gmv - normal_gmv, 2) AS gmv_diff,
  ROUND(promo_aov - normal_aov, 4) AS aov_diff,
  ROUND((promo_aov - normal_aov) / NULLIF(normal_aov, 0), 4) AS aov_diff_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN promo_flag = 1 THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS promo_gmv,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN promo_flag = 1 THEN order_id END) AS promo_ord_cnt,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN promo_flag = 1 THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END)
          / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN promo_flag = 1 THEN order_id END), 0), 4) AS promo_aov,
    SUM(CASE WHEN promo_flag = 0 OR promo_flag IS NULL THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS normal_gmv,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN promo_flag = 0 OR promo_flag IS NULL THEN order_id END) AS normal_ord_cnt,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN promo_flag = 0 OR promo_flag IS NULL THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END)
          / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN promo_flag = 0 OR promo_flag IS NULL THEN order_id END), 0), 4) AS normal_aov
  FROM orders
) t LIMIT 1000

results.sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN quantity IS NULL OR quantity = 0 THEN '未知单价'
    WHEN total_amount / NULLIF(quantity, 0) < 100 THEN '0-99'
    WHEN total_amount / NULLIF(quantity, 0) < 200 THEN '100-199'
    WHEN total_amount / NULLIF(quantity, 0) < 300 THEN '200-299'
    WHEN total_amount / NULLIF(quantity, 0) < 500 THEN '300-499'
    WHEN total_amount / NULLIF(quantity, 0) < 1000 THEN '500-999'
    ELSE '1000+'
  END AS price_band,
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_cnt,
  SUM(quantity) AS qty_sold,
  ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS gmv,
  ROUND(SUM(total_amount) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders), 0), 4) AS gmv_share,
  ROUND((SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders), 2) AS total_gmv
FROM orders
GROUP BY price_band
ORDER BY qty_sold DESC, gmv DESC LIMIT 1000

SELECT
  t.category AS 品类,
  ROUND(COALESCE(o.actual_amount, 0), 2) AS 实际销售额,
  ROUND(t.target_amount, 2) AS 目标销售额,
  ROUND(COALESCE(o.actual_amount, 0) / NULLIF(t.target_amount, 0), 4) AS 目标达成率
FROM (
  SELECT category, SUM(target_amount) AS target_amount
  FROM sales_target
  GROUP BY category
) t
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT category, SUM(total_amount) AS actual_amount
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY category
) o ON o.category = t.category
ORDER BY 目标达成率 DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: 广东省卖得最好的品类是什么
results.sql: SELECT category, SUM(total_amount) AS sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_cnt, ROUND(SUM(total_amount) / (SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE region = '广东'), 4) AS sales_share FROM orders WHERE region = '广东' GROUP BY category ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 1
